notes.title: NEW TRAILERS!
notes.notes:
[i][b]In case you missed it…[/b][/i]

Here at Perp, we’re extremely excited to share that the highly anticipated 2025 title, The Relic: First Guardian, was recently featured in the Future Games Show Summer Showcase and IGN Live Showcase (Day 3).

Both shows featured brand new and unseen gameplay that showcases the game’s impressive combat system, varied biomes and hulking enemies. 

In this action RPG, you embark on a heroic adventure to save the world in the dark as the last guardian. The once-prosperous Arsiltus was swallowed up by the void created by the destruction of the great relic and transformed into the land of death. Now your mission is to find the pieces of the broken great relic and close the void. You are the last hope of the Arsiltus.

Check the new trailers out and Wishlist now. Coming 2025.
